analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a resilient Q1 FY27 performance despite industry-wide supply-side constraints and geopolitical tensions affecting raw material costs. The company achieved 35% year-on-year revenue growth and expanded its product portfolio with new complex fertilizer variants to meet evolving agricultural needs. Management expects improved capacity utilization and production levels in the coming quarters as raw material availability stabilizes. The company remains confident in its growth trajectory, supported by favorable monsoon conditions and government subsidy frameworks. Krishana Phoschem reported a 34.58% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, driven by expanded capacities and operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line increase of approximately Rs. 500 crore for FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand remains strong despite production declines, as evidenced by significant year-on-year sales growth in NPK and SSP.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite lower production levels, sales remained strong, with NPK sales increasing by 33% year- on-year and SSP sales growing by 28% year-on-year during the same period.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival in early July has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif sowing.
demand_outlook.quote: This pivot has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif growing across our primary marketing zone.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the Kharif season demand environment to be constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The government's fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27 is expected to support farmer affordability and sector stability.
demand_outlook.quote: The Cabinet's approval of NBS rates for Kharif 2026, alongside a fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27, underscores the government's commitment to farmer affordability & sector stability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects fertilizer demand to remain stable due to the essential nature of agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities but has not yet finalized or disclosed details.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its Meghnagar facility with NPK/DAP capacity at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a capacity expansion increasing NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company has no further expansion plans currently.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25%–30% of the increase in input costs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margin pressure in the first quarter of FY27 due to rising input costs.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per ton for NPK is expected to remain around Rs. 6,000 with a variance of 3-4%.
margins_costs.quote: For NPK, EBITDA of around Rs.6,000 per ton may vary slightly, within a range of approximately ±3% to 4%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total NPK-DAP capacity is 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 capacity utilization was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
The company achieved total fertilizer production of 397,263 MT for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split to enhance market liquidity and broaden the shareholder base.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The recent capacity expansion was funded through a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia have introduced uncertainty regarding shipping routes and increased procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices have risen significantly due to issues related to the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July. The issues related to the Strait of Hormuz have significantly impacted sulphur prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input cost volatility and supply uncertainties remain key risks for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: The company will begin sourcing green ammonia under a 10-year agreement starting in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the recent capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to receive green ammonia supply after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
